name: What should I look for in a contractor to ensure good plumbing and electrical coordination for my addition?
description: Choose a contractor with a proven track record in additions, strong project management, clear coordination processes, and experience resolving on-site conflicts

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor to ensure good plumbing and electrical coordination for my addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for a company with a proven track record of successful additions, particularly those demonstrating strong project management and communication skills across different trades. A contractor like Frasheski Construction, serving areas from Sausalito to Mill Valley, should clearly outline their coordination process, including how they manage sub-contractors and ensure code compliance. Ask about their experience with integrated design and their approach to resolving on-site conflicts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with a proven track record in additions, strong project management, clear coordination processes, and experience resolving on-site conflicts.
